contract.age_definition: i minus flip index; flip OPEN is age zero
contract.d0_rule: d0 > TRAIN q1/3; no upper bound
contract.exit: first BULL OPEN or maximum OPEN

reconciliation.mechanism: legacy study required 24 future daily bars; horizon/reflip study required 12. Short segment gates also used that maximum. Recomputing TRAIN terciles can move boundary signals.

paired_holdout_reflip_improvement.scope: paired reflip-minus-fixed improvement; temporal blocks and same-day clustering, not account returns

walk_forward.kind: retrospective annual expanding and rolling two-year train-only replay
walk_forward.selection: TRAIN reflip PF at 40bp; D0 q1/3 from purged TRAIN; deterministic shorter-hold tie break
walk_forward.honesty: all years are already observed research data; these folds are not untouched forward OOS

limitations: HOLDOUT and replay years were already inspected; not pristine OOS
Signal statistics do not impose maximum positions, exposure, or liquidation; no account return or MDD claim
Flat 20-100bp round-trip costs; historical funding is not available or included
No TP/SL; exits execute at observed daily OPEN; no one-minute chronology required
Full-day source availability is a retrospective data-integrity filter; source universe includes historical listing/delisting coverage only
